[ITST.10.1] **A product has two coverage numbers.** Its line and branch
coverage is the share of its own source lines, and of its own source
branches, that its tests execute. Its clause coverage is the number of
clauses, per prefix, for which a linked test counts ([STYL.5.3.11]) and the
product is one of that test's class. Neither stands in for the other: a line
a test executes is not a claim the test checks.
